title: A Chinese Dev Built A Free Money Printer
description:
A Chinese dev built a free money printer and literally named it MoneyPrinterTurbo.
13,000 stars on GitHub, and it does the one thing creators pay thousands to automate.
You type a topic. It writes the whole script for you.
Then it pulls HD copyright-free footage, drops in subtitles, adds music, and generates a voiceover.
You get a finished short video. No editing, no timeline, nothing.
The script gen runs on Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, or GPT, whatever you already pay for.
It batch-makes a dozen versions at once so you just pick the winner.
9:16 for TikTok and Reels. 16:9 for YouTube.
It runs on your machine. Web UI, API, Docker, even Google Colab if you don't want to install a thing.
No subscriptions. No watermarks. No limits.
Creators are renting half of this for 50 bucks a month.
This is the exact pipeline behind faceless channels pulling six to ten grand a month, and it costs you zero.
Follow if you'd rather print money than rent the printer.
